Jasper is the leading AI marketing platform, enabling the world's most innovative companies to reimagine their end-to-end marketing workflows and drive higher ROI through increased brand consistency, efficiency, and personalization at scale.
Jasper has been recognized as "one of the Top 15 Most Innovative AI Companies of 2024" by Fast Company and is trusted by nearly 20% of the Fortune 500 – including Prudential, Ulta Beauty, and Wayfair. Founded in 2021, Jasper is a remote-first organization with team members across the US, France, and Australia.

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO , you will be a trusted strategic partner and force multiplier for our CEO, helping him operate at his highest level of impact. This role demands exceptional organizational skills, strong communication abilities, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.

Alongside this strategic remit, you'll also manage the CEO's schedule, travel, meeting materials, and other administrative essentials — with the same precision and attention to detail.

This role demands exceptional judgment, strong communication abilities across all levels of the organization, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.
This role reports to the Senior Manager, Executive Operations, and works in close daily partnership with the CEO. The role is open to candidates located in the UK, with a strong preference for someone based in London. While this is a fully remote role, there may be times when meeting the CEO and various partners in our London office is necessary, so flexibility to work out of this office is required.

s.h: What You Will Do At Jasper
s.t:
Manage the CEO’s schedule to arrange meetings, triage incoming requests, and ensure that all deadlines are met effectively.
Coordinate and facilitate communication between the executive and other internal team members, ensuring clear and effective collaboration.
Support the Executive Team working cadence including weekly meetings, regular brainstorming sessions and quarterly offsites.
Own travel arrangements and external engagement logistics with meticulous attention to detail, building contingency plans so nothing is left to chance.
Assist with key priorities including preparing necessary materials and organizing the CEO’s workflow.
Proactively identify issues and implement solutions to maintain momentum on critical activities.
Prepare materials and organize workflow to keep the CEO's key priorities moving forward.
Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Executive Operations and cross-functional leaders to strengthen and continuously improve executive operations processes.
Support the CEO's engagement with the Board and other senior stakeholders, including helping prepare materials and coordinate logistics for Board meetings and other high-stakes, elevated communications.
What You Will Bring To Jasper
7+ years of experience as an executive assistant or in a similar administrative role, ideally supporting C-level executives — with 2-4+ years directly supporting a CEO or Founder strongly preferred.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort communicating at the Board and executive level.
Sound independent judgment and decision-making — able to distinguish between what to run with and what to escalate.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and autonomously.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and external contacts.
Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

The expected base salary range offered for this role is £85,000 - £100,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Administrative Support

Assist with project coordination and task tracking

Research and book travel arrangements (flights, hotels, transportation)

Coordinate virtual and in-person meetings or events
Operations & Task Management
Support day-to-day business operations

Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency

Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
High attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work independently in a remote environment

This is an independent contractor position. Compensation is based on a percentage of client monthly plans, with average monthly earnings ranging from $1,500-$3,800, depending on client mix.
Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:
No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates
No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment

Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to support@zirtual.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support Figma’s Chief People Officer and VP, Talent to strategically manage the day-to-day administrative and operational needs of the People organization, while also contributing significantly to projects and initiatives that help drive the company’s priorities.

You’ll be responsible for keeping the leaders and teams organized, aligned, and helping them maintain focus while scaling for growth and delivering an exceptional internal and external experience.

This role will strategically manage day-to-day administrative and operational needs, infuse Figma’s culture and values in the work to create a meaningful Figmate experience, and cross-functionally collaborate with the broader People Org and stakeholders across Figma.

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant who has supported at a VP or C-Suite level before. Experience with People or Talent Teams is a bonus.

This is a full-time role based out of our SF Hub.

· Support the Chief People Officer and VP, Talent with calendar, travel, meetings, agendas, preparation, tasks, notes, emails.

· Serve as a strategic thought and execution partner to your Executives and their leadership teams, with a focus on team cohesion, operations, and planning.

· Identify areas to optimize the Executives’ time and make recommendations regarding time management, prioritization, and business needs.

· Partner with internal teams to ensure cross functional alignment on projects, company milestones, and internal events – this will include some ad hoc project management

· Act as a delegate for your Executives by signing off on expenses, approving POs, and managing other tooling as needed, with careful attention to internal policy.

· Find opportunities for process optimization across team and company workflows.

· Prepare and/or build content, presentations, and key documents for your leaders

· Partner cross-functionally with the People Team and other internal teams to ensure alignment on projects, company milestones, and internal events.

s.h: We’d love to hear from you if you have
s.t:
· 7+ years of experience in a senior administrative support role.

· Experience working in a fast-paced environment with the ability to adapt quickly to changing demands.

· Outstanding communication skills and the ability to connect with a broad spectrum of stakeholders internally and externally, both in person and online.

· The ability to shift gears and prioritize based on the volume and urgency of requests.

· Expertise in prioritizing, connecting dots, and anticipating needs.

· A commitment to being trustworthy, reliable, and maintaining the strictest confidentiality.

· Dedication to fostering inclusivity and navigating initiatives through an optimistic lens.

s.h: While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have
s.t:
· Experience with our product suite.

· Supported teams of 100+ people (bonus points for complex global teams).

· Previous experience supporting People or Recruiting teams.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.
This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.
This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.
This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.
You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.
Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience
Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.
Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.
Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.
Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.
Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.
Coordinate Office Operations
Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.
Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.
Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.
Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.
Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.
Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.
Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.
Support office utilization reporting.
Leadership & Administrative Support
Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.
Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.
Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.
Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.
This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.
Support Gatherings & Connection
Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.
Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.
Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.
Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.
Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.
Build Strong Relationships
Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.
Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.
Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.
Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.

5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
Full professional proficiency in English and German.
This position needs to be based in the Berlin office 5 days a week.

s.h: How We'll Take Care of You
s.t: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.

This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.

This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.

This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.

You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.

Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience

· Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.

· Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.

· Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.

· Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.

· Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.

Coordinate Office Operations

· Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.

· Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.

· Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.

· Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.

· Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.

· Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.

· Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.

· Support office utilization reporting.

Leadership & Administrative Support

· Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.

· Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.

· Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.

· Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.

This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.

Support Gatherings & Connection

· Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.

· Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.

· Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.

· Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.

· Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.

Build Strong Relationships

· Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

· Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.

· Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.

· Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.

· 5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.

· Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

· Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

· Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.

· Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

· Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.

· Full professional proficiency in English.
This position needs to be based in the London office 5 days a week.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.
About the Workplace & Real Estate Team
The Workplace & Real Estate team builds the places where LangChain builds the future of AI agents. Our job is to make every office somewhere people want to be, spaces that run flawlessly, feel great to walk into, and reflect the craft bar of the company in every detail.

We treat the workplace as a product: designed with intent, measured, and continuously improved. We run a small, high-agency team of on-site owners in each hub, and we automate the manual work rather than adding it, across two master-lease hubs (SF, NY) and coworking spokes as the company scales.

The Office Manager owns our SF HQ end-to-end, both the on-the-ground experience and the systems that make it run. SF is our largest hub and headquarters, and we regularly host company and team offsites.

You open and reset the space first thing every morning and are the face of the office through the day, and you build the tooling, standards, and vendor programs that keep it running consistently as we scale. This is a hands-on role for a builder who takes pride in a flawless space and in the systems behind it.
Location: This role is based on-site in our San Francisco (HQ) office, five days per week.

Own the space & the craft bar
Open and reset the space first thing every morning, before people arrive, the office is clean, stocked, and ready
Keep the space super organized, neat, tidy, clean, and stocked at all times; it should always be on point and represent the quality of the company
Run a regular walkthrough punch list and stay on top of the details
Be the face of the office
Present through business hours as front-of-house: greet guests, welcome and guide new hires and visitors, and be the person people find
Plan and run local in-office events, team moments, and the offsites hosted at HQ
Run operations, vendors & budget
Manage facilities, supplies, snacks, and equipment; own on-site vendor relationships (cleaning, food, maintenance); serve as primary contact for building management and repairs
Rationalize and manage vendor programs, move us off ad-hoc ordering to contracted, consistent programs
Own budget tracking for the office; help track cost-per-seat and utilization; partner with Finance
Build the systems & standards

Deploy and own the workplace tech stack; desk booking, room scheduling, visitor management, mailroom/deliveries, partnering with IT on networking

¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Collibra is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer. Experience managing expenses, budgets, and administrative processes.

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA.
Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques.
Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique.
Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients.

Contexte
Chez BULL, nous concevons et déployons des systèmes informatiques à haute performance, d'intelligence artificielle et des technologies critiques au service des infrastructures stratégiques. En tant que leader européen indépendant, BULL se positionne à la pointe de l'innovation et de l'excellence industrielle.
Dans le cadre du remplacement d'un départ en retraite au sein de la R&D, le poste est maintenu et rattaché à la Business Unit ECN. Il s'inscrit dans un périmètre transversal et mutualisé entre nos activités ECN et nos équipes R&D.
En tant qu' Executive Assistant , vous intervenez au cœur du leadership exécutif. Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous apportez un support organisationnel et opérationnel de haut niveau visant à garantir l'alignement stratégique, la fluidité des opérations et l'efficacité de la prise de décision.
Responsabilités principales
Vos Missions S'articulent Autour De La Gestion Des Priorités Exécutives, Du Suivi De La Gouvernance Et De La Performance Opérationnelle
Pilotage de l'agenda et organisation exécutive
Orchestrer, optimiser et arbitrer l'agenda ainsi que le rythme exécutif de la direction dans un environnement complexe et très réactif.
Planifier et coordonner les instances de gouvernance, réunions de direction et événements exécutifs.
Organiser les déplacements complexes (nationaux et internationaux).
Préparation des livrables et suivi des décisions
Préparer et consolider les supports stratégiques (dossiers, notes de cadrage, présentations de niveau direction, synthèses).
Assurer le suivi rigoureux ( follow-up ) des décisions clés, des plans d'action et des initiatives de transformation.
Suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et dashboards de la direction.
Communication, synthèse et interface stratégique
Rédiger des communications et comptes-rendus à fort niveau d'exigence et de synthèse.
Assurer l'interface privilégiée et fluide entre la direction, les lignes d'affaires ECN, la R&D et les parties prenantes externes de haut niveau.
Traiter la correspondance, le filtrage des sollicitations et garantir la stricte confidentialité des dossiers confiés.

Formation & Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions de support exécutif (Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner) ou de gestion d'entreprise auprès de dirigeants. Expérience confirmée au sein d'organisations internationales , matricielles et à fort rythme.
Requis
Solide culture d'entreprise et compréhension fine des enjeux et priorités stratégiques d'une direction générale.
Excellente maîtrise de la suite Microsoft 365 et des outils de collaboration exécutive.
Capacités rédactionnelles, de communication et d'esprit de synthèse de haut niveau.
Bilinguisme parfait en Français et Anglais (usage quotidien à l'oral comme à l'écrit avec des interlocuteurs internationaux).
Optionnel

Soft Skills
Posture de partenaire de confiance, sens élevé de la responsabilité et présence exécutive.

Rigueur, diplomatie, aisance relationnelle et discrétion absolue.
Pourquoi postuler ?
Ce poste offre une exposition directe aux prises de décision stratégiques au sein d'un leader européen de la technologie. Vous jouerez un rôle de bras droit exécutif à fort impact sur la performance opérationnelle des entités ECN et R&D, au sein d'un environnement stimulant.

Si vous recherchez un poste d'assistanat classique sans exposition aux enjeux stratégiques et sans proximité directe avec un niveau de direction générale (EVP).

We’re looking for an experienced, full-time Executive Assistant to join our team in Berlin and support our Co-CEOs, Lennard and Judith.
In this role, you’ll work closely with our Co-CEOs, Lennard and Judith, as part of a young, entrepreneurial team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love bringing order to hectic schedules, and approach each day with a proactive mindset, we’d love to meet you.
We’re looking for someone highly organized, calm, self-motivated, and adaptable.

Internal organisation and steering. You run the CEO's operating rhythm. Calendar, inbox triage, meeting preparation, and follow-through all sit with you. You keep an eye on details and you keep the leadership cadence (weeklies, board preparation, offsites) moving.
External travel and speaking. You plan and book complex international travel end to end, and you manage the speaking pipeline: inbound requests, selection, briefing packs, and logistics on the ground.
C-level relationship management. You become the trusted point of contact for the CEO's most important external relationships: customers, partners, and investors. You track who needs a touchpoint and when, and protect these relationships through reliability and proactivity.
Augmentation and anticipation. You work half a step ahead of everyone else in the room. You can identify a bottleneck before it forms. You build the systems, defaults and briefings that let the CEO spend their time on judgement rather than logistics.
Admin. You manage expenses and finance admin and can support with occasional personal assistant (PA) duties as needed.
CEO office collaboration. You’ll work in very close coordination with the CEO office, which includes a Chief of Staff and CEO Office Manager who are responsible for operational processes in the CEO office. Incl. performance management, KPI tracking, leadership accountability and strategic projects.
You Might Be a Fit If…
You have previously supported a CEO or equivalent in a demanding organisation and are looking for another environment that gives you an opportunity to grow.
You want to be in a young, fast company. You are comfortable with ambiguity, short timelines and a team that is still writing its own playbook, and you would rather shape the system than inherit a finished one.
You are mission-driven. You care that European companies build and adopt AI, and you want your work to count toward that rather than toward a job title. You are eager to automate your own work where possible.
AI can do a lot of things, but in the short term, it won't be able to shepherd a growing group of mostly young people in a very dynamic environment. We are looking for someone who can foster the most important human qualities within the organization.
We are looking for a long-term partner, not someone optimizing for their next role.
Personified calmness – You bring order, not chaos. When things get hectic, you're the person who slows down, thinks clearly, and helps others do the same. Your presence makes people feel like things are under control. You instill calmness and continuity in the organization.
Good judgment – You know what matters and what doesn't. You read people well. You understand when to push and when to give space, when something is urgent and when it can wait.
Compassionate and empathetic – You care about the people around you. You understand that behind every missed deadline or dropped ball is a human with hidden context. You hold people accountable with kindness.
Ownership mentality – You see problems and fix them without being asked. You don't wait for permission. You follow through.
Strong communicator – Written and verbal. You can draft important emails or have a difficult conversation with equal skill.
Trustworthy – You'll have access to everything and work directly with the CEO. Discretion and trust are very important.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.
The Environment
We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.
Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.
The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.
We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.
Next steps
We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.
If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

## Description du poste ##
En qualité de coordinateur ou coordinatrice gestion des locaux, vous assurez la coordination des demandes liées à l'attribution des locaux, aux aménagements des espaces de travail ainsi qu'aux déménagements des activités et des collaborateurs et collaboratrices au sein des HUG.
Interlocuteur ou interlocutrice privilégiée du personnel, vous analysez les besoins exprimés et veillez à leur cohérence avec la stratégie immobilière institutionnelle ainsi qu'avec le schéma directeur des HUG.
Vous évaluez les demandes, proposez des solutions adaptées et recherchez des alternatives permettant une utilisation efficiente des surfaces et des ressources mises à disposition.
Vous pilotez de manière autonome les mandats d'aménagement et de déménagement de faible à moyenne complexité, depuis leur planification jusqu'à leur réalisation. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants et intervenantes internes et externes, assurez le suivi des prestataires et veillez au respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences réglementaires.
Vous participez activement à l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes concernées par les mouvements d'activités ou les réorganisations d'espaces.
Vous assurez également la gestion et la mise à jour de la signalétique de proximité en collaboration avec la Direction de la communication, tout en veillant au respect de la charte graphique institutionnelle.
Enfin, vous contribuez au maintien et à la fiabilité des inventaires graphiques et alphanumériques des locaux ainsi qu'à la qualité des données de gestion immobilière.

Vous possédez des connaissances des normes et réglementations applicables aux espaces de travail, notamment en matière d'ergonomie, de sécurité et d'aménagement des locaux.
Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques usuels. Une expérience sur des logiciels de dessin ou de gestion des espaces constitue un atout.
Vous avez un excellent sens du service, vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'organisation dans la conduite de vos activités.
Votre aisance relationnelle, votre capacité à coordonner et votre aptitude à accompagner le changement vous permettent d'évoluer efficacement dans un environnement hospitalier en constante évolution.
Vous avez d-excellentes capacités d'analyse, êtes pragmatique et proposez des solutions adaptées aux besoins du personnel tout en tenant compte des contraintes institutionnelles.

# Coordinator of the CAS in Quantum Science at D-PHYS, ETH Zurich #
#### 60%, Zurich, fixed-term ####
print Drucken
The Department of Physics (D-PHYS) at ETH Zurich pursues a diverse research agenda and a broad teaching program. These encompass diverse areas of physics, ranging from the fundamental principles of nature to innovative technologies for society. The Institute of Theoretical Physics (https://itp.phys.ethz.ch/), D-PHYS, ETH Zurich is seeking to hire a Coordinator who will lead the new continuing education program in quantum science. The appointment is expected for a 60 % full-time equivalent.
## Project background ##
The Certificate of Advanced Studies (CAS) in Quantum Science at ETH Zurich is designed to provide digital technology experts, engineers, and professionals in banking or government with a strong foundation in quantum science and its emerging applications.

Bringing together expertise from across D-PHYS and the ETH Quantum Center, the programme combines high-level academic teaching with insights into foundations and current developments in quantum technologies.

The CAS Coordinator will play a central role in the development, launch, and implementation of the programme and will serve as the key interface between the CAS directors, participants, lecturers, the ETH School for Continuing Education (SCE), and other internal and external partners.
## Job description ##
As the Coordinator of CAS in Quantum Science, you will oversee and contribute to the development, launch, and implementation of the CAS in Quantum Science.

You will work closely with the CAS directors, D-PHYS professors and study administration, ITP administration and act as the central point of contact for the ETH SCE, as well as with other relevant units at ETH Zurich, including the ETH Quantum Center.

Your responsibilities will include coordinating the curriculum and program schedule, supporting the selection and admission of participants, managing communication with participants and lecturers, and overseeing the program-s administration, budget, and implementation.

You will also contribute to the program-s communication and marketing activities, support the recruitment of participants, and serve as the central point of contact for the program.

s.h: You will be responsible for and contribute to
s.t:
* Development, conceptualization and management of the continuing education program (CAS) in Quantum Science and its administration
* Communication and coordination with the lecturers, D-PHYS study secretariat, SCE and the ETH Quantum Center.
* Representation of the CAS and outreach regarding its activities.
* Contacts with internal and external academic and industry parties.
* Coordination of marketing and communication for the program in collaboration with colleagues SCE and D-PHYS.
* Serving as a main contact point for prospective students and organizing the student selection process.
## Profile ##
* Excellent multi-stakeholder project management skills, including the ability to drive and manage different workflows and effectively prioritize your time based on needs, goals and opportunities.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent English language skills, both written and verbal. Proficiency in the German language facilitates interactions with German-speaking administration and prospective participants.
* Prior experience in a similar role with demonstrated success is an asset.
* University degree with a deep understanding of quantum science. Master's degree or PhD in quantum science and technology is an asset.
* Experience and/or interest in concepts and/or implementations of quantum science and technology.

## Workplace ##

**Über Syngenta**
Bei Syngenta Crop Protection entwickeln wir wegweisende Lösungen, die die globale Ernährungssicherheit schützen und gleichzeitig eine nachhaltige Landwirtschaft fördern. Als Weltmarktführer mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz befähigen wir Landwirte mit innovativen Pflanzenschutztechnologien, die gegen die härtesten Herausforderungen der Natur schützen.

Wir verbinden fortschrittliche Wissenschaft mit digitalen Lösungen, um intelligenten Pflanzenschutz zu entwickeln, der Erträge maximiert und gleichzeitig die Umweltbelastung minimiert. Werden Sie Teil unserer Mission, den Pflanzenschutz von der Aussaat bis zur Ernte zu revolutionieren.
Wussten Sie, dass Syngenta den Friendly Working Space Zertifikat hat?

Bei Syngenta sind die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden der Mitarbeitenden der Schlüssel zum Unternehmenserfolg. ## Job Description ##
Bei Syngenta ist es unser Ziel, das kollaborativste und vertrauenswürdigste Team in der Landwirtschaft aufzubauen, das qualitativ hochwertiges Saatgut und innovative Pflanzenschutzlösungen bereitstellt, die den Erfolg der Landwirte verbessern. Zur Unterstützung dieser Mission sucht das Hiring Team von Syngenta eine(n) **Maintenance Coordinator (in)** Onsite in Kaisten, Schweiz.
Der Maintenance Coordinator trägt die Verantwortung für die Bewirtschaftung und Weiterentwicklung des Instandhaltungs-Management-Systems sowie für die Koordination der präventiven und korrektiven Instandhaltungsaktivitäten. Ergänzend dazu übernimmt die Rolle aktiv Aufgaben im Bereich Reliability Engineering - mit dem Ziel, die Anlagenzuverlässigkeit systematisch zu steigern und Programme zur mechanischen Integrität und Anlagensicherheit am Standort umzusetzen.
**Aufgaben:**
**Instandhaltungskoordination**
* Verwendung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Maintenance Management Systems in der SAP-Umgebung (PM-Modul)
* Planung, Koordination und Unterstützung von Instandhaltungsaktivitäten im Normalbetrieb sowie während Abstellphasen
* Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Wartungsplänen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem technischen Personal und Fachspezialisten
* Monitoring der Umsetzung des präventiven Instandhaltungsprogramms zur Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Konformität mit gesetzlichen und Syngenta-internen Vorgaben
* Koordination und Unterstützung beim Einsatz von Fremdhandwerkern und Erteilung von Aufträgen an externe Fachfirmen
* Bewirtschaftung des technischen Ersatzteillagers sowie Beschaffung von technischem Material und Dienstleistungen
* Aufbau und Pflege der Equipment- und Anlagenhistorie
* Erstellung von Berichten und Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs) zum Instandhaltungsprogramm
* Erstellen, Ausarbeiten und Aktualisieren von Arbeitsanweisungen und technischer Dokumentation
**Reliability Engineering**
* Unterstützung und Leitung von Initiativen zur mechanischen Integrität der Anlagen
* Unterstützung und Leitung der Implementierung globaler Programme, z. B. Sicherheitskritische Anlagen, Kritikalitätsanalyse und zugehörige FMECA-Analysen
* Weiterentwicklung des Reliability-Programms am Standort, inklusive Zustandsüberwachungsprogramm und daraus abgeleiteter Massnahmen, Auswertung von Resultaten aus Prüfungen und Inspektionen
* Unterstützung und Pflege des Bad Actor-Programms: systematische Erfassung und Bearbeitung von wiederholt störungsanfälligen Anlagen und Komponenten
* Leitung oder Mitarbeit bei Projekten zur Zuverlässigkeitssteigerung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

* Abgeschlossene Berufslehre in einem technischen Bereich (z. B. Polymechaniker/in, Anlagen- oder Betriebsmechaniker/in, Elektrotechnik o.ä.)
* Technische Weiterbildung, z. B. Techniker HF, Meister oder vergleichbar - von Vorteil
* Sehr gute SAP-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Modul PM
* Grundkenntnisse in Reliability Engineering-Methoden (FMECA, RCM, RCA, Condition Monitoring) von Vorteil
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP in der Instandhaltung
* Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von verfahrenstechnischen oder chemischen Produktionsanlagen
* Erfahrung in der Planung und Koordination von Abstellphasen (*Shutdowns*) von Vorteil
* Kenntnisse im Bereich Anlagenzuverlässigkeit und/oder mechanische Integrität von Vorteil
* Selbständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
* Analytisches Denkvermögen und Fähigkeit zur Priorisierung in einem komplexen Umfeld
* Teamfähigkeit und konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern
* Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Dienstleistern und Projektpartnern
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Muttersprache oder gleichwertig); Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
* Urteilsvermögen: Fähigkeit, in der eigenen Verantwortung fundierte technische Entscheidungen zu treffen
* Ausführungs- und ergebnisorientiert: konsequente Umsetzung von Massnahmen bis zum Abschluss
